attempts.summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted volume (2GiB file-backed loop device at /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img, mapper name secure_srv) on node1, formatted it XFS, and mounted it at /srv/secure. Configured /etc/crypttab and /etc/fstab with a root-fs-resident keyfile (/etc/luks-keys/secure.key, mode 400) so it unlocks and mounts automatically at boot with no manual intervention. Verified end-to-end with a full node reboot: boot_id changed (fbdf5b2c... -> 175dd2d7...), the cryptsetup and mount systemd units came up active on their own, and pre-restart test data written to /srv/secure survived.
